# v0.4.2 — release automation

Release-engineering release: no library-code changes since 0.4.1. Full changelog:
[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/cyberd4ch/txn-agent/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Highlights

**Tag → release, hands off.** The publish workflow now builds the sdist/wheel,
generates `SHA256SUMS.txt`, creates the GitHub release (notes from
`.github/releases/<tag>.md` when present), and attaches every artifact — one
`git tag vX.Y.Z && git push` is a complete release.

**Self-owned coverage badge.** CI writes the real percentage to the `badges`
branch and the README renders it via shields.io (Codecov uploads were failing on
a runner-side TLS handshake; that upload remains best-effort).

**Repo presence finalized.** URLs point at `cyberd4ch/txn-agent`; topics, homepage,
and the distributor pitch are live. PyPI publication still awaits the one-time
trusted-publisher configuration (see `docs/deploy.md` §8).

**Assets below are built by CI from the tag** — verify with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
